project.name: Reaper
native_surfaces: native FFI, editor and embedded contracts

quality.intent: Language correctness, diagnostics, state isolation and regression evidence.

criteria.requirement: Lexical errors identify invalid input and preserve actionable source context.
criteria.verification: Language tests cover tokenization and lexical failure behavior.

criteria.requirement: Parser failures remain explicit and valid syntax produces a stable program structure.
criteria.verification: Parser and language tests exercise valid and invalid programs.

criteria.requirement: Runtime governance and execution boundaries remain explicit and testable.
criteria.verification: Governance tests cover the runtime policy boundary.

multiplicity.intent: Repeated compilations and executions are predictable, replayable and isolated.

criteria.requirement: Optimizer passes preserve semantic behavior and stable output for equivalent input.
criteria.verification: Native optimizer tests protect the transformation boundary.

criteria.requirement: Intermediate representation remains consistent across repeated front-end and lowering stages.
criteria.verification: Language and IR tests guard stage-level invariants.

criteria.requirement: Federated or bulk operations define idempotent replay, bounded inputs and per-item failure reporting.
criteria.verification: The federation module and its tests form the extension point; explicit replay guarantees remain a release criterion.

native.intent: The C11 front end, Python runtime and FFI remain direct, aligned and independently verifiable.

criteria.requirement: The C11 lexer and parser remain independently buildable and tested.
criteria.verification: Native C lexer tests exercise the front-end boundary.

criteria.requirement: The Python runtime preserves the primary package API and documented CLI behavior.
criteria.verification: Runtime tests cover extended execution paths.

criteria.requirement: Embedded/native interoperability uses an explicit FFI boundary and ownership model.
criteria.verification: Embedded FFI tests cover boundary behavior.
